question.title: Spark 1: Set up and show up
question.description: Four things from your first day: the Google Form, your profile, your post in the group chat and your replies. About 5 minutes. A red star * means you must answer.
question.completedHtml:
Thank you. We have your Spark.

A SupaMoto Academy reviewer will check it. If something is missing, you can send the Spark again.

elements.name: custom:googleFormLink
elements.html: Do the Google Form first: forms.gle/1RZWYSzkcpzTXQuw8 (also in the group chat).

elements.name: schema:image_profileScreenshot
elements.title: Send a screenshot of your profile set up successfully.
elements.description: The profile you set up today. Take the screenshot after it is fully set up. On most phones you take a screenshot by pressing the power button and volume-down together, then find the picture in your Gallery.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please add the screenshot of your profile.

elements.name: schema:image_groupPostScreenshot
elements.title: Send a screenshot of your post in the group chat.
elements.description: Your post must show your name, one talent (any talent, big or small) and what you look forward to in the programme. If your post is long, send two screenshots.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please add the screenshot of your group chat post.

elements.name: custom:googleFormCompleted
elements.title: I was able to fill in the Google Form.
elements.description: Choose True if you filled it in. If you could not, choose False. You can still send this Spark and fill in the Google Form later.

elements.name: schema:image_commentRepliesScreenshot
elements.title: Send a screenshot of your replies to at least two comments on another learner's post.
elements.description: One screenshot is fine if both replies are in it. You can add more than one.
elements.requiredErrorText: Please add the screenshot of your replies.
